decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed telecommunications mast, by reason of its design, appearance and siting would represent a visually obtrusive and discordant form of development that would have a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the surrounding area. The proposed location of the 20 m high monopole would also cause less than substantial harm to the setting of the grade II listed former college and the setting of the Battersea Park Conservation Area. The proposal would therefore not meet with the relevant conditions attached to Class A of Part 16 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order and would be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), policy SI6 of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1, LP3, and LP22 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).
site_name: Telecommunications Mast Wdw081 On Pavement Outside Entrance Tesco Car Park
application_type_full: Prior Approval: Development for electronic communications network
description: Determination as to whether prior approval is required for the installation of a new 20 metre high monopole supporting 9 no. antennas with a wrap around equipment cabinet at the base of the column, the installation of 3 no. new equipment cabinets, and ancillary development thereto.
